safeDeal.coverLoadersBody: Loading jobs are settled against attendance proof, so crews are credited for work that is verified rather than merely booked.
safeDeal.coverSellersBody: Parties, quantity and grade are confirmed with both sides before the goods move, so a trade never starts on a misunderstanding about what was agreed.
safeDeal.coverSub: SafeDeal doesn’t stop at the seller — it covers logistics and labour too.
safeDeal.coverTransportersBody: Freight is recorded against a completed trip: pickup and delivery are each verified with a one-time code, so a job counts as done only when it actually is.
safeDeal.coverWorkersBody: A worker’s assignment records check-in and completion, so a shift that was worked is on the record and not a matter of memory.
safeDeal.ctaBody: Trade on AgroTraders with SafeDeal. Every auction and every awarded bid is checked by an agent before a single crate moves.
safeDeal.g1: Every auction and bid deal checked by an agent before dispatch
safeDeal.g2: Pickup and delivery each confirmed with a one-time code
safeDeal.g3: Neutral dispute resolution by the AgroTraders team
safeDeal.g4: Every step logged and auditable end-to-end
safeDeal.heroBody: Auctions and buy requests on AgroTraders settle through SafeDeal. An AgroTraders agent contacts both sides, confirms the parties and the terms, and clears the deal before anything is dispatched — so no shipment starts on a trade nobody has checked.
safeDeal.heroTitle: Every deal is checked before your goods move
safeDeal.holdBody: The moment a lot is won or a bid is awarded, the order is created and held. The seller cannot mark it packed or dispatch it until an AgroTraders agent has verified the deal with both sides. If it does not check out, the goods never leave the yard.
safeDeal.holdTitle: Nothing is dispatched until an agent clears it
safeDeal.howSub: Four steps — nothing ships until the deal has been checked.
safeDeal.step1Body: Win an auction or award a buy request and AgroTraders creates the order for you, with both sides, the quantity and the agreed price recorded against it.
safeDeal.step2Body: An AgroTraders agent contacts the buyer and the seller to confirm who they are, what is being traded and how payment is being settled. The order stays locked until that check clears.
safeDeal.step3Body: Only once the deal is cleared can the seller dispatch. Pickup and delivery are each confirmed with a one-time code — the seller’s at collection, yours at the door — so the handover is on the record, not just someone’s word.
safeDeal.step3Title: 3 · Dispatch, with a code at each end
safeDeal.step4Body: Check the stock against the agreed grade and quantity when it reaches you. If anything is wrong, raise a dispute and the AgroTraders team steps in.
